pages.text: $(o)Do not come to the island confident.$(br)Three creatures that never knew the Order keep it: the Demon Knight, the Celestial Swordsman and the Sky Stalker.$(br2)They are not sentinels: they are what was left when the rehearsal was abandoned.
Search the island. Somewhere, kept inside an Arcane Safe, is the Construction Altar.$(br2)Bring it back to the Portal, beside its libraries.
You now have the Construction Altar. Carry it to the Portal, beside its libraries: the altar's outline waits there, marked with runes. Place it on the outline and set the Almanac on its left lectern.
